non_inferences: Do not treat VarietyInformation.type as a recipe addition instruction; it is mapped to descriptive variety roles.
Do not parse BeerJSON substitutes free text into material references.
Do not fold BeerJSON inventory into hop material identity or invent a material lot from its amount-only stock record.

Do not assume every PercentType nested under BeerJSON OilContentType is a fraction of total oil merely because the source object description says so; field-level analytical meaning controls native mapping.
Do not reinterpret ambiguous BeerJSON pinene, polyphenols, xanthohumol, or cohumulone percentages without a defensible denominator/identity.
